title: Find what you *already* do well
lede: A few short questions and playful activities. No exams, no certificates — just you.
existing: You already have a skill profile.
existingSub: You can view it, or discover again to update it.

interests.title: What kind of work do you *enjoy*?
interests.hint: Choose one or more. There are no wrong answers.
interests.need: Choose at least one to continue

attention.title: Find the *matching* pictures
attention.hint: Tap every picture that looks exactly like the one at the top.

sequence.title: Put the steps in *order*
sequence.hint: How do you make a cup of tea? Tap the steps in the right order.
steps: Pour water into the pan and heat it
Add tea leaves and let it boil
Add milk and sugar, boil again
Strain the tea into a cup
sequence.tryAgain: Not quite — that step comes later. Try another.

coordination.title: Tap at the *right moment*
coordination.hint: The ring will shrink. Tap the big button when the ring touches the gold circle.

scenarios.title: What would *you* do?
scenarios.hint: Choose the answer that feels most like you.

items.q: A customer at a shop is upset because their order is late.
options: Listen calmly and say sorry, then find out when it will come
Ask the owner to come and handle it
Tell them it is not my fault

items.q: The fan at home suddenly stopped working.
options: Check the switch and plug first, then look for the problem
Wait for someone else to fix it

items.q: A shelf in a shop is messy and items are mixed up.
options: Sort items by type and put labels
Make it look nice with colours and a pattern
Leave it, customers will find things

experience.title: What have you *done* before?
experience.hint: Paid or unpaid — at home, on a farm, in a shop. It all counts.

reveal.title: Here is what we *noticed*
reveal.next: What would you like to do next?
reveal.saathiPrompt: I just finished my skill profile. What should I do next?
